paper.one_line_finding: With ChatGPT on Days 2 to 6, the treatment group scored higher on AUT novelty (Day 6: 39.84 vs 14.80; t = -4.84, P 0.000; Table 2a p. 8, Table 1 p. 11) and on the expert rating of solution novelty ('Creativity' in Table 2b), but not on Day 7 without ChatGPT (AUT novelty 17.60 vs 13.02, P 0.053; solution novelty P 0.122; Tables 2a and 2b p. 8, Table 1 pp. 11-12), while its AUT answers stayed more similar at Day 30 (SBERT 0.39 vs 0.33, p ≤ .001; p. 14, Table 3 p. 16).
